seoTitle: The Legend of Korra Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Legend of Korra test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Korra, Mako, Bolin, Asami, Tenzin, Lin, Jinora or Varrick — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the headstrong hero, the tough one or the wise soul? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, family and big responsibilities, and find out which Legend of Korra character you are.

characters.name: Korra
characters.title: The Headstrong Hero
characters.summary: Bold, confident and always ready to jump in. You act first, and learn the hard lessons along the way.
description: Like Korra, you're full of confidence. She's the Avatar, and she starts out athletic, headstrong and ready for anything.
You get knocked down, and you get back up. Korra bounced back after losing her bending, and again after Zaheer's attack left her badly hurt.
You grow through the hard times. Korra started a whole new Avatar cycle, and eventually found love with Asami.
characters.flaw: You charge in before you've thought it through.
characters.signature: A running start and absolutely no plan B.
characters.clashReason: they'd charge ahead before you've finished explaining the plan

characters.name: Mako
characters.title: The Serious One
characters.summary: Level-headed, loyal and a little bit brooding. You keep your head when everyone else is losing theirs.
description: Like Mako, you grew up fast. He was raised on the streets of Republic City with his brother Bolin.
You're a natural leader. Mako captained the Fire Ferrets pro-bending team.
You work hard and get noticed for it. Mako rose from beat cop to detective in the Republic City police.
characters.flaw: You can come across as cold when you're really just being careful.
characters.signature: A serious face, a sharp eye and a plan that actually works.
characters.clashReason: they'd brood quietly while you're trying to have fun

characters.name: Bolin
characters.title: The Big Heart
characters.summary: Cheerful, funny and endlessly enthusiastic. You make everyone around you feel better.
description: Like Bolin, you're everyone's favourite friend. He's the cheerful, easygoing comic relief of Team Avatar.
You surprise people. Bolin, an earthbender, discovered he could lavabend.
You grow into yourself. Bolin learned he could help in ways that go far beyond fighting.
characters.flaw: You trust people a little too quickly.
characters.signature: A big grin, a terrible joke and a hug for everyone.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn your serious conversation into a joke

characters.name: Asami
characters.title: The Capable One
characters.summary: Composed, clever and quietly unstoppable. You handle the hard stuff without making a fuss.
description: Like Asami, you can handle almost anything. She's a skilled driver, fighter and inventor.
You step up when it counts. Asami took over Future Industries after her father was imprisoned.
You're the friend people lean on. Asami became Korra's closest confidant, and later her girlfriend.
characters.flaw: You hold everything together so well that nobody asks if you're okay.
characters.signature: A calm smile, car keys in hand and a solution already in mind.
characters.clashReason: they'd have it all sorted before you even knew there was a problem

characters.name: Tenzin
characters.title: The Traditionalist
characters.summary: Responsible, principled and a little bit uptight. You take your duties seriously, maybe too seriously.
description: Like Tenzin, you carry a lot of responsibility. He was the only airbending master at the start of the series.
You feel the weight of big expectations. Tenzin is the son of Avatar Aang and Katara, and he worries about living in his father's shadow.
Family means everything to you. Tenzin and his wife Pema have four children.
characters.flaw: You worry so much about doing things properly that you forget to relax.
characters.signature: A neat plan, a deep breath and a lecture ready just in case.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you a lecture when you only wanted a hand

characters.name: Lin
characters.title: The Tough One
characters.summary: Blunt, fearless and fiercely protective. You don't do warm and fuzzy, but you'd go to war for the people you love.
description: Like Lin, you're tough as nails. She's Republic City's Chief of Police and a metalbender.
You don't trust easily. Lin first sees Korra as a threat, then grows to protect her.
You can mend what's broken. Lin eventually reconciles with her sister Suyin and her mother, Toph.
characters.flaw: You keep people at arm's length for far too long.
characters.signature: A hard stare, a short answer and a promise you'll always keep.
characters.clashReason: they'd shut down your ideas with one blunt sentence

characters.name: Jinora
characters.title: The Wise Soul
characters.summary: Calm, thoughtful and wise beyond your years. You see what others miss, and you take your responsibilities seriously.
description: Like Jinora, you're mature for your age. She's Tenzin and Pema's eldest daughter.
You have a deep, thoughtful side. Jinora has a special connection with spirits, and guides Korra in the Spirit World.
You work hard, and it pays off. Jinora earned the title of airbending master.
characters.flaw: You can take everything so seriously that you forget to have fun.
characters.signature: A quiet word of wisdom, and a feeling about something nobody else noticed.
characters.clashReason: they'd quietly point out what you've been avoiding

characters.name: Varrick
characters.title: The Showman Inventor
characters.summary: Eccentric, brilliant and full of wild ideas. Every day's a pitch, and you're the star of it.
description: Like Varrick, you think big. He's a nonbending billionaire and an eccentric inventor.
You change your mind, and sometimes your side. Varrick worked for Kuvira, then deserted her to help Team Avatar.
You know who keeps you going. Varrick married his loyal assistant, Zhu Li.
characters.flaw: Your big ideas run ahead of everyone else's patience.
characters.signature: A wild new idea and someone else to make it work.
characters.clashReason: they'd talk over you to pitch their latest big idea

questions.text: You're running late, and the bus pulls away just as you arrive. You...

options.text: Sprint after it. You can definitely catch it
Call a car, and get some work done on the way
Wait for the next one, and enjoy the quiet moment
Walk. Complaining won't make it come back

questions.text: A friend tells you about a wild plan. You...

options.text: Point out every way it could go wrong
Say yes before they've finished explaining
Say no. Flatly
Make it even bigger

questions.text: A relative keeps telling you how you should live your life. You...

options.text: Ignore them, and do it your way anyway
Thank them, and consider whether they have a point
Tell them, bluntly, to mind their own business
Give them some advice back, at great length

questions.text: Your afternoon plans get cancelled. You...

options.text: Meditate, or read somewhere quiet
Start building something you thought up that morning
Get restless, and go looking for something exciting
Call your friends, and see who's free

questions.text: A coworker keeps making the same mistake. You...

options.text: Cover for them, and fix it quietly
Point out the mistake once, and expect it fixed
Leave it. It's not your job to fix them
Crack a joke to make them feel better

questions.text: You're planning a family holiday. You...

options.text: Make a detailed schedule with every stop
Sort out the travel, and do all the driving
Suggest somewhere peaceful, out in nature
Skip it. You'd rather stay home and work

questions.text: Someone you care about is in trouble. You...

options.text: Charge straight in
Think it through, and make a smart plan first
Throw money and wild ideas at the problem
Protect them fiercely, then never mention it again

questions.text: You get some bad news. You...

options.text: Go quiet, and deal with it on your own
Need a hug from everyone, immediately
Start planning how the whole family will cope
Stay calm, and focus on what you can control

questions.text: You're offered a big promotion, with a lot more pressure. You...

options.text: Accept, and worry about living up to the person before you
Accept, and announce big changes on day one
Ask for time to think about whether it's right for you
Turn it down. You'd miss the fun parts

questions.text: Two friends ask you to settle an argument. You...

options.text: Pick a side quickly, and loudly
Hear both sides, then give a fair answer
Roll your eyes. They're both being ridiculous
Find a practical compromise they can both live with

questions.text: You can bend fire, water, earth or air, and a gang is threatening your neighbourhood. You...

options.text: Take them on yourself, right now
Report them, then help with the investigation
Organise the neighbourhood, and run it like a fortress
Try to talk them into switching sides

questions.text: You inherit a huge company just as it's falling apart. You...

options.text: Roll up your sleeves, and turn it around
Launch an outrageous new invention to save it
Ask your family what they think is the right thing to do
Hand it to someone who loves spreadsheets. Offices aren't your thing
